home.title: CodeQuestions
home.tagline: Master your tech interview. One question at a time.
home.ctaDesc: CodeQuestions is open source. Add questions by submitting a Pull Request — just edit a markdown file.
home.step1Desc: Each question includes a thorough explanation for deep understanding, plus a concise summary crafted for the interviewer.
home.step2Desc: Flip the flashcard and answer without looking. Test what you truly know — not just what you think you know.
home.step3Desc: Mark questions as "Got it" or "Need more study". Progress is saved locally in your browser — no login required.
